query:
SELECT 
  id,
  client_name,
  client_email,
  total_amount,
  asaas_charge_id,
  payment_status,
  sync_status,
  recorded_at
FROM fuel_records 
WHERE asaas_charge_id IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY recorded_at DESC 
LIMIT 3;
